name: Age of Umbra
description: The Halcyon Domain, a century into its own ruin. God-King Othedias — chosen bridge between the Veiled Gods and mortals — conspired with the Grand Ordinants and the Aetherlords to change the nature of divine power itself; the gods answered with the Apostasy, shattering much of the Old World and abandoning it outright. What's left is the Age of Umbra: an amorphous, unknowably intelligent dark cloud that sweeps the land like a storm, reaping the souls of the dead and twisting them into nightmarish, risen things. Scattered enclaves survive only by tending their own Sacred Pyres, whose light wards off the Umbra's corruption — among them Desperloch, defended by five individuals who rose to protect it. Factions fill the space the gods left behind: the hedonistic, ruthless raiders of the Damask Queens, the Celsians, the Enduring, and Zealot cults still fervently seeking a way to commune with the absent gods. This is a deadly, grimdark, Soulsborne-inflected campaign frame — there is no resurrection here.
